units.source_text: 他关注沙地，怎么说都没有错。

en.t: There was nothing wrong, however one put it, with his paying attention to sandy ground.

units.source_text: 事实上，斑蝥也是沙漠里有代表性的昆虫。

en.t: In fact, the tiger beetle was also a representative insect of the desert.

units.source_text: 又有一说，它那难以捉摸的飞行方法，其实是一种诡计：

en.t: According to another theory, its elusive way of flying was actually a kind of trick:

units.source_text: 它要把看中的小动物从它们的窝里引诱出来。

en.t: it would lure the small animals it had marked out away from their burrows.

units.source_text: 譬如老鼠或壁虎，被那小虫引诱到沙漠的深处迷了路，

en.t: For example, mice or geckos, drawn on by that little insect, would lose their way deep in the desert,

units.source_text: 小斑蝥一直候着小动物饥饿、疲乏至死，

en.t: and the little tiger beetle would keep waiting until the small animals died of hunger and exhaustion,

units.source_text: 然后把它们的尸体拿来当自己的美餐。

en.t: then take their corpses as its own fine meal.

units.source_text: 就像信天翁那样，拥有一个优雅的日本名字，

en.t: Like the albatross, it had an elegant Japanese name,

units.source_text: 乍一看气度非凡，但实际上却是尖嘴猴腮，

en.t: and at first glance it seemed to have an extraordinary bearing, but in reality it was sharp-mouthed and pinched-faced,

units.source_text: 具有不惜同类相残的狰狞凶猛性格。

en.t: with a ferocious, savage nature that would not shrink even from killing its own kind.

units.source_text: 这个说法是真是假且不必说，

en.t: Whether this account was true or false need not be discussed for the moment;

units.source_text: 至少男人被斑蝥妖气十足的步伐迷住了；

en.t: at least, the man had been captivated by the tiger beetle's uncanny, almost demonic gait;
